description_for_human: Free privacy-first PDF toolkit. Encrypt, redact, watermark, sanitize, flatten, repair PDFs — all in the browser, no uploads.
description_for_model: DocInspector provides free client-side PDF processing tools. All operations run locally in the browser using WebAssembly — no files are sent to any server. Available tools: encrypt PDF with password, add text watermarks, redact sensitive content, sanitize/remove metadata, flatten form fields, repair corrupted PDFs, generate PDF bundle summaries (borderou), and remove digital signatures. Supports batch processing of multiple files. Also available as a desktop application.
